audited_source_corrections.action: Defined the rotation subgroup by rational multiples of pi rather than rational radian values, and clarified closure and the zero-angle inverse.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source calls angles in [0,2pi) with rational radian values a group. For rational r>0, the inverse angle 2pi-r is generally irrational, and sums reduced modulo 2pi need not be rational. The subsequent half-group doubling proof also requires closure modulo 2pi.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: கோணங்களை பையின் பகுத்தெண் மடங்குகளாக வரையறுத்து, முழுச் சுற்று அளவில் கோப்பு மூடப்பட்டிருப்பதையும் பூச்சியச் சுழற்சியின் எதிருறுப்பையும் தெளிவுபடுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining rational radian values while claiming nonexistent inverse closure; allowing all real rotations, which would lose countability.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Rational multiples of pi modulo 2pi form a countable abelian subgroup; each half specified by [0,pi) and [pi,2pi) maps onto the whole under squaring.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the selected rotation set countable, closed under composition and inverses, and compatible with the half-group doubling lemma?

audited_source_corrections.action: Used the defined first rotation half instead of an undeclared R_1 in the D_1 partition proof.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source introduces rotationsgroup_1 and rotationsgroup_2, but then indexes the D_1 pieces by R_1, which has no declaration in this proof.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: D_1 இன் துண்டுகளை முன் வரையறுத்த முதல் சுழற்சிப் பாதியின் உறுப்புகளால் குறியிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating R_1 as silently synonymous with rotationsgroup_1.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: D_1 is by definition the union over rotationsgroup_1 of rho(C); its countable partition has exactly those indices.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the partition proof use precisely the declared rotationsgroup_1 index set?

audited_source_corrections.action: Quantified rho over the rotation group, not over the representative point set C, in both congruence and equal-measure claims.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The final proof twice writes rho in C, although C is a set of points and rho is applied as a rotation. All pieces in the disjoint cover are indexed by the rotation group.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: இரு இடங்களிலும் rho சுழற்சிக் குழுவின் உறுப்பு என்று வரம்பிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the type error and informally reading a point as a rotation.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: For any rotation rho, rho(C) is congruent to sigma(C); invariance gives the common measure used in the countable sum.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both congruence and equal-measure statements quantify over the same rotation index set as the final cover?

audited_source_corrections.action: Made the measurable domain rotation-invariant so measurability of one rotated representative piece implies measurability of every congruent piece.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source assumes a measure on some sigma-algebra and equality of measures for congruent measurable sets, then infers that every rotated C is measurable from one measurable rotated C. Equality on pairs already in the domain does not itself make the domain rotation-invariant.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: அளவிடத்தக்க கணங்களின் களம் கருதப்படும் சுழற்சிகளின்கீழ் மூடப்பட்டிருக்க வேண்டும் என்ற நிபந்தனையை வெளிப்படையாகச் சேர்க்கிறது; அளவிட முடியாதது என்பதன் பொருளையும் இம்மாறாமைச் சூழலுக்குள் வரம்பிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating invariance of the numerical value as silently implying closure of the sigma-algebra domain.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: If one rotated piece belongs to a rotation-stable measurable domain, all its rotations do; then equal measures and countable additivity yield the displayed contradiction.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corollary state the domain condition needed to transfer measurability among all rotation images?
